cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Committee,

I am a computer engineer and lecturer with a PhD focus on trustworthy AI and natural language processing. My recent work on human-centered evaluation metrics for clinical AI systems and on hybrid summarisation models shows I can design metrics and models that balance performance with interpretability. As head of a department and co-founder of a technology centre, I have led interdisciplinary teams and managed research grants, including participation in COST projects on AI-driven image analysis and data privacy.

At Deepgram, I would apply my experience in building evaluation frameworks to the development of latent space models for voice. My background in combining extractive methods with large language models mirrors the challenge of factorising audio representations into interpretable dimensions. I enjoy turning research ideas into usable tools, as seen in my utility model for smart refrigerator monitoring and a patent on secure smart doors.

I am comfortable experimenting with new AI tools and adapting quickly to evolving research directions. I look forward to contributing to Deepgram's mission of making voice AI universally accessible.

Best regards,
Anıl Kuş
